description: CS210 final roadmap: analysis and recursion, linear structures, sorting, trees, heaps, hashing and graphs, with the material to study for each topic, look-alikes and a coverage tracker.
lede: CS210 is about choosing the right structure. First learn to measure cost (Big-O), then the linear structures, sorting, the tree family, heaps and hash tables for fast access, and finally graphs for connections.
